data.narrative:
CX2 Industries is a Series A–stage defense and security company that has raised $31M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparables across the sector: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy for current valuation, applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A step-ups to the next funding round, yielding $62M. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same-stage comparables: Stark Defence at $4.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M. The median of this three-company set is $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. These two methods produce a wide spread reflecting heterogeneity in the peer set.

The triangulated valuation range is $53M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $231M. The substantial width of this range—nearly a full order of magnitude—reflects genuine uncertainty: CX2's positioning relative to high-outlier peers like Stark Defence versus lower-priced comparables remains a critical driver. Key uncertainties include market traction, technical differentiation within the defense sector, and the degree to which CX2 commands Stark Defence–level or NODA AI–level risk pricing at this stage.
